hero.title: Service Support.
hero.description: Comprehensive maintenance and technical lifecycle support for our range of premium acoustic and automatic systems.

items.title: Annual Maintenance
items.description: Scheduled maintenance support for automatic systems including motorized barriers, roof sliding systems, and telescopic gates to ensure long-term operational integrity.

items.title: Acoustic Support
items.description: Post-installation service support for sound proof windows, acoustic movable wall partitions, and specialized acoustic door systems.

items.title: Installation Coordination
items.description: Site-readiness coordination, installation sequencing, and handover support for acoustic partitions, doors, windows, and motorized movement systems.

items.title: Technical Consultation
items.description: Direct engineering support for architectural projects, from initial acoustic specification to final on-site installation and calibration.

items.title: System Upgrades
items.description: Modernization of legacy manual systems to automated movement, including integration of modern drive systems and sensor controls.

supportProgram.title: Support Program: From Specification To Handover.
supportProgram.description: Kiran Slido Craft supports projects from acoustic specification and shop-drawing coordination through fabrication, installation, commissioning, and post-installation service.

features.title: Specification Review
features.description: Engineering review for STC targets, opening dimensions, movement requirements, hardware selection, and project-specific constraints before fabrication.

features.title: Installation Support
features.description: Coordination for track alignment, sealing details, motorized drive setup, and final fitment of acoustic and automation systems.

features.title: Service Continuity
features.description: Annual maintenance, retrofit recommendations, system upgrades, and corrective service planning for long-term operational reliability.

footer.text: For active projects, share drawings, dimensions, acoustic targets, movement type, and site location so the engineering team can recommend the right support path.

assist.label: Ready to Assist
assist.title: International Standards, Indigenous Support.
assist.description: Kiran Slido Craft provides technical response times and support availability that matches our high engineering quality.
